Here is what I found about the story “Sydney researcher wins PM’s science prize for cancer vaccine”:

---

## What actually happened

- **Award**: On 24 November 2026, Professor Georgina Long of the University of Sydney and the Melanoma Institute Australia was jointly awarded the **Prime Minister’s Prize for Science**. ([abc.net.au](https://www.abc.net.au/news/science/2026-11-24/2026-prime-minister-prize-for-science/107415808?utm_source=openai))  
- **Co-recipient**: The prize was shared with Professor Anthony Thomas, a physicist from the University of Adelaide. ([abc.net.au](https://www.abc.net.au/news/science/2026-11-24/2026-prime-minister-prize-for-science/107415808?utm_source=openai))  
- **Prize value**: The Prime Minister’s Prize for Science carries a reward of **AU$250,000**. ([abc.net.au](https://www.abc.net.au/news/science/2026-11-24/2026-prime-minister-prize-for-science/107415808?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Georgina Long’s cancer vaccine work

- **Nature of research**: Long’s work is focused on **melanoma treatment**, particularly using immunotherapy and mRNA-based technologies. ([sydney.edu.au](https://www.sydney.edu.au/news-opinion/news/2026/11/24/sydney-researchers-take-top-honours-in-the-2026-prime-minister-s.html?utm_source=openai))  
- **Clinical trial**: A recent landmark phase-3 clinical trial showed that an **individualised mRNA-based melanoma vaccine** (called *intismeran*) combined with immunotherapy significantly reduced the risk of melanoma recurrence or death over two years. ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/24/georgina-long-melanoma-anthony-thomas-2026-prime-ministers-prizes-for-science?utm_source=openai))  
- **Specific result**: That vaccine trial found a **42% reduction** in the risk of recurrence or death compared to immunotherapy alone. ([brisbanetimes.com.au](https://www.brisbanetimes.com.au/national/sydney-researcher-behind-breakthrough-cancer-vaccine-wins-pm-s-science-prize-20261124-p61gvy.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What the prize is for

- The Prime Minister’s Prize recognition was awarded for Long’s **transformative work in melanoma treatment**, including earlier breakthroughs in drug therapies and updated international clinical guidelines, **not** specifically for the new vaccine trial. The vaccine trial came too late to be part of her nomination. ([sydney.edu.au](https://www.sydney.edu.au/news-opinion/news/2026/11/24/sydney-researchers-take-top-honours-in-the-2026-prime-minister-s.html?utm_source=openai))  
- Her research had already improved survival rates by large margins: about **10-fold for stage IV melanoma** and **24-fold for melanoma with brain metastases**. ([sydney.edu.au](https://www.sydney.edu.au/news-opinion/news/2026/11/24/sydney-researchers-take-top-honours-in-the-2026-prime-minister-s.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Outcome vs. announcement/plans

- **Completed outcome**: The phase-3 trial showing vaccine efficacy (42% reduction in recurrence or death) is a **measured outcome**. The trial is done, results published. ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/24/georgina-long-melanoma-anthony-thomas-2026-prime-ministers-prizes-for-science?utm_source=openai))  
- **Award**: The prize is an **award/recognition** for Long’s body of work, largely prior achievements in melanoma therapy and guideline changes, not for the vaccine trial per se. ([industry.gov.au](https://www.industry.gov.au/news/meet-recipients-2026-prime-ministers-prizes-science?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Independent sources / confirmation

- The **Australian Government’s Department of Industry, Science and Resources** published the official list of recipients, confirming that Long won the top science prize for her work in melanoma. ([industry.gov.au](https://www.industry.gov.au/news/meet-recipients-2026-prime-ministers-prizes-science?utm_source=openai))  
- **ABC News** also reported the award, noting the vaccine breakthrough among Long’s recent work and quoting trial results. ([abc.net.au](https://www.abc.net.au/news/science/2026-11-24/2026-prime-minister-prize-for-science/107415808?utm_source=openai))  
- **The Guardian** described the vaccine trial, its results (including the 42% risk reduction), and clarified that the vaccine finding was too new to be included in the nomination. ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/24/georgina-long-melanoma-anthony-thomas-2026-prime-ministers-prizes-for-science?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Fact-checking the candidate’s summary

- **“Cancer vaccine developed by a Sydney researcher has won a prestigious science prize”** — partially correct: the researcher has *led* development and recent trials of an mRNA cancer vaccine, and she *did* win the prize, but the prize was awarded for her broader melanoma research, not specifically for the vaccine trial outcome.  
- **“Breakthrough cancer vaccine”** — yes, the trial results represent a breakthrough (phase-3 clinical trial, significant reduction in recurrence/death), but the vaccine work was not the basis for the prize nomination.  

---

If you want, I can pull up the original published clinical trial paper for the vaccine for more technical details (sample size, statistical significance, etc.).

Here is a factual research note on the event “Community commits to bay recovery, rejects macropuerto” in Portmán, Spain, dated November 24, 2026:

---

## What Happened

On **November 24, 2026**, *Frente Amplio* (a political coalition in the Region of Murcia) formally signed a **neighborhood/community commitment** in Portmán. The commitment was initiated by **Ecologistas en Acción** and joined by 19 neighborhood, social, and ecological organizations. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))

Through this commitment:

- They pledged to **push for the environmental recovery** (“recuperación ambiental”) of the *Bahía de Portmán* (Portmán Bay). ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  
- They explicitly **rejected the project of the macropuerto de El Gorguel** (a large container‐port proposal). The argument is that this macropuerto is incompatible with the ecological restoration of Portmán. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))

---

## Details of the Proposal (What Is Being Proposed, Not Yet Delivered)

The agreement outlines a specific alternative to previous plans:

- Use of **partial dredging** (dragado parcial) of the bay’s sediment to recover part of the original coastline, rather than a full “seal” (sellado total) of the bay’s dumped mine tailings (estériles). ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  
- Creation of a **new beach**, recovery and rehabilitation of the historic Portmán fishing port through removal of sediments, construction of breakwaters (“diques de abrigo”), and restoring the ancient harbor uses. ([murciaeconomia.com](https://murciaeconomia.com/art/109944/colectivos-vecinales-y-ecologistas-exigen-a-los-partidos-un-compromiso-firme-para-regenerar-la-bahia-de-portman?utm_source=openai))  
- Rehabilitation of the **Sierra Minera** (mining region) and the *ramblas* (seasonal streams) feeding into the bay to prevent further input of contaminated sediments. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  

The agreement explicitly demands that any future government **definitively discard** the Macropuerto de El Gorguel project. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))

---

## Outcome vs. Status

- This development is **not yet a completed or measured change**. It is a **political commitment** signed by a party (Frente Amplio) and various organizations. No physical works or construction has commenced under this specific agreement. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  
- The macropuerto project is being rejected in political terms under this commitment, but that does **not yet mean it has been officially canceled or legally prohibited**. It remains a point of political and social contestation. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  

---

## Broader Context

- These demands build on long‐standing debates. Since the 1950s/60s, mineral tailings from mining operations dumped into Portmán bay (until about 1991) have severely degraded the coastline, obliterating the original shore and historic port. ([murciaeconomia.com](https://murciaeconomia.com/art/109944/colectivos-vecinales-y-ecologistas-exigen-a-los-partidos-un-compromiso-firme-para-regenerar-la-bahia-de-portman?utm_source=openai))  
- In 2025, the Spanish central government (Ministry for Ecological Transition, *MITECO*) had proposed the “sellado total” (total sealing of the bay), which was rejected by local ecologist, social groups, and local government. They preferred a partial dredging solution. ([rrnews.es](https://rrnews.es/2025/05/vecinos-ecologistas-rechazan-sellado-portman.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Sources

**Primary source:**  
- Cadena SER article dated **today** (Nov 24, 2026), “Frente Amplio firma en Portmán el compromiso por la recuperación de la bahía y rechaza el macropuerto de El Gorguel,” which reports on the signing of the commitment. ([cadenaser.com](https://cadenaser.com/murcia/2026/11/24/frente-amplio-firma-en-portman-el-compromiso-por-la-recuperacion-de-la-bahia-y-rechaza-el-macropuerto-de-el-gorguel-radio-murcia/?outputType=amp&utm_source=openai))  

**Independent corroboration:**  
- La Opinión de Murcia (similar article matching Cadena SER’s reporting);  
- MurciaEconomía, La Boquera de Murcia, and other local/regional media that describe the same event: the signing of a commitment rejecting El Gorguel and defending partial dredging and ecological restoration. ([murciaeconomia.com](https://murciaeconomia.com/art/109944/colectivos-vecinales-y-ecologistas-exigen-a-los-partidos-un-compromiso-firme-para-regenerar-la-bahia-de-portman?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Summary

- On **November 24, 2026**, Frente Amplio in Murcia signed a formal agreement with community, ecological, and neighborhood groups in Portmán to pursue environmental recovery of Portmán Bay.  
- The agreement includes rejecting the **macropuerto de El Gorguel**, supporting **partial dredging** of mine tailings, restoring coastline and historical port, and rehabilitating upstream sources of pollution.  
- As of this commitment, **no construction or cancellation** has been enforced—this is a political pledge rather than a completed outcome.

---

If you like, I can check legal documents or government actions to see if there is formal cancellation or funding commitment for these proposals.

Here’s a factual research note based on live sources for the event “Birth of a rare bison in national park” relating to Meshchera National Park, Vladimir Oblast, Russia:

---

## What happened

- A calf of the European bison (зубр) was born in the demonstration enclosure (вольер) at Meshchera National Park (нацпарк «Мещёра») in Vladimir Oblast. ([vladimir-smi.ru](https://vladimir-smi.ru/item/767717?utm_source=openai))  
- The newborn is a female. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  
- The birth is believed to have occurred during the night of **November 14–15, 2026**. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  
- As of approximately November 23, 2026, the calf has “stronger-than-confident” standing ability, is drinking water and sampling grain. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Additional Information

- The mother temporarily disappeared from view around that time, raising concern among park inspectors who then assumed a calf was imminent. She returned with the calf. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  
- The calf remains under observation from a distance, to avoid disturbing the mother–calf bond. Visitors are restricted from feeding the bison by hand or approaching the enclosure fence closer than one meter. ([newsvladimir.ru](https://newsvladimir.ru/fn_1996058.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Context & Population Details

- Within the walled “demonstration enclosure” at Meshchera near the village of Savinskaya, the population of bison was recently over nine animals. ([vladimir-smi.ru](https://vladimir-smi.ru/item/767717?utm_source=openai))  
- The broader wild populations in Vladimir Oblast, particularly in the Muromsky and Klyazminsko-Lukhskiy reserves (заказники), have also been producing “late autumn calves,” which is uncommon because bison calves are more often born in early summer. ([vladimir-smi.ru](https://vladimir-smi.ru/item/767717?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Outcome vs. Launch/Pledge/Announcement

- **Completion/Measured outcome**: The birth of a healthy female bison calf is a completed and observed event. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  
- It is *not* merely an announcement, pledge or plan. The calf is already alive, standing, and engaging in feeding behavior. ([6tv.ru](https://6tv.ru/mat-propala-a-potom-vernulas-s-popolneniem-imya-dlya-novorozhdennoj-malyshki-zubra-mogut-predlozhit-vladimircy?utm_source=openai))  

---
